    Cokernels spanned by given rows #

    In characteristic two the derivative cokernels need not vanish (prop:residual-correction-spaces, positive-deformations.tex): each periodic component contributes at most one line, spanned by a single row. We record "the cokernel classes of all rows of degree at least three lie in the span of the classes of the rows in S" (CokerSpan), and show that it is preserved by rescaling arrows and entire mesh relations (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "rescaling arrows and entire relations changes the mesh derivative by invertible diagonal maps, so it changes neither its cokernel …").
